g.title: The app code. index.tsx is /, about.tsx is /about and blog/[slug].tsx is a dynamic route. _app.tsx, _document.tsx and nested files that start with an underscore are skipped.

Bun.Glob scans src/pages once at startup. Each file becomes a URL pattern compiled to a regular expression with a capture group per [param], and match() returns the first route that fits along with its params.

Bundles client.tsx for the browser as ES modules with code splitting. A plugin supplies the virtual module unnexted:pages, a map from each page's file path to a literal import(), so every page becomes its own chunk. It runs at every server start.
Build output. Bun.serve returns .js and .js.map files from here by file name, with no-cache in development and a one-year max-age in production.

Reads the embedded data, looks up the page loader in unnexted:pages by file path, imports only that chunk and calls hydrateRoot with the same props, so React attaches handlers to the server HTML instead of re-rendering it.

renderPage imports the matched page module and awaits getServerSideProps with params and pathname, merging the result into the props. An unmatched path renders 404.tsx with status 404, and a failed import or throwing data function returns a plain 500 page.

react-dom/server renders the page into an HTML template. The pathname, props and page file path are written into a script tag with id __UNNEXTED_DATA__ as JSON with the less-than sign escaped, so the data cannot close the tag.
